description: Join me in this hilarious and relatable video where I share my everyday experiences living in the US, and the funny reactions I get from my family and friends when I tell them about the food and culture here. From trying new and exotic dishes to navigating the ups and downs of daily life, I'm excited to take you along on this journey with me. Get ready to laugh and be entertained as I share my stories and adventures in this video. Don't forget to like and subscribe for more fun and exciting content.
